Keep instruction b3 outside; Deut4:39 is embedded in first paragraph. In Birnbaum /aleinu ends BEFORE Deut4:39 (at ככתוב בתורתו), which is a separate Bible verse scope. Preserve exact requested extraction scope; select full parent or explicit through-verse extent when whole first paragraph is intended.

directed_but_unprinted.note: Whole Kaddish/Titqabbal; printed direction only. Expanded service needs compatible external witness and quorum; do not present external text as daytwo transcription.
